title: contract opportunities - u.s. embassy in tanzania
paragraphs: in many cases, the u.s. government can only do business with companies which are registered in the system for award management (sam). what’s an example of a case in which sam is required? any award of $30,000 or more given by the u.s. embassy in dar es salaam may only be made to a vendor which is registered in sam. it’s important that you register in the sam database as soon as possible so you can take advantage of opportunities with the u.s. government.

the embassy of the united states of america (usg) dar es salaam has a requirement to source for. conference tables (modern office folding flip top mobile training table 55″d x 23.6″w x 29.5″h – qty 10 conference chairs (stackable conference room chairs with wheels and paddle folding office chair foldable desk chair mesh back and arms – qty 80 costs proposals are due september 17, 2024, at 17:00hrs eat. we encourage you to submit both a hard copy and an electronic version of your proposal. kindly state the expected delivery time after you have received purchase order. electronic submissions should be sent to dargsoprocurement@groups.state.gov with subject line rfq – pr12788253: cdc – office furniture (conference chairs and tables). closing date: 17:00hrs sep. 17, 2024.
